Title: 14 sticky notes down 🥹💪🏽 The first two weeks of 75 Soft have been good overall. I’ve had some setbacks, and finishing might take me a little longer, but I’m still going to complete this challenge. These two weeks showed me what needs more attention: protein, fibre, water and strength training. So that’s what I’m locking in on for the next 60 days! Currently bloated because my period decided to join the journey 😂 but overall I feel good, and I’m not giving up. Title: DAY 30 OF 75 | Renovating a Home for Mom! ❤️🏠 My mom’s landlord is selling the house she’s renting, and she has to move out before January. She’s on a fixed income, and finding affordable housing isn’t easy. So we bought another fixer-upper mobile home, and I’m giving myself 75 days to completely renovate it and give it to her for Christmas! 🎁 After spending 64 days renovating our own $7,000 trailer, we’re doing it all over again. But this time, it’s for someone who means the world to me. ❤️ Follow along as I balance running my junk removal business, raising a family, and trying to pull off the ultimate Christmas gift for my mom! 75 days. One trailer. One Christmas deadline. Let’s see if we can pull this off! 🔨🎄 #MobileHomeRenovation #ChristmasForMom #75DayChallenge #DIYRenovation #ChrisssFam
Author: Chrisss Fam

Title: I’ve honestly debated whether or not to share my 75 Hard journey, especially this video. I’m still nowhere near where I want to be, but life is too short to hide the messy middle. I started 75 Hard on September 30th with one goal: a permanent lifestyle change, not another fad diet. Living with a chronic illness has completely rewritten how my body can move. This hasn't just been a mental challenge, it’s been an intense physical battle every single day. I’m incredibly grateful for my amazing team of specialists helping me navigate my pain and get into the best shape possible, both mentally and physically. Here’s to the end of letting chronic illness control my life. Here’s to showing my kids what resilience, health, and a productive lifestyle actually look like. 🤍 #chronicillness #75hard #weightloss #mom #healthylifestyle
Author: Destyne | Lifestyle Creator
